name: hlsl-lsp
description: DXC-powered HLSL IntelliSense through the Language Server Protocol.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: HLSL-LSP executes a native language server and reads shader include files.

hlsl.server.path.description: Path to an external hlsl-lsp executable. The first workspace folder selects this setting for the window and resolves a relative path. When empty, the platform-specific bundled server is required.

hlsl.trace.server.description: Controls Language Server Protocol tracing in the HLSL-LSP output channel.

hlsl.languageVersion.description: Default DXC HLSL language version. An explicitly configured editor value overrides shadertoolsconfig.json; the default does not.

hlsl.preprocessorDefinitions.description: DXC preprocessor definitions. An explicitly configured object replaces file-derived definitions; use an empty object to clear them.

hlsl.additionalIncludeDirectories.description: Existing DXC include directories. The value is selected from the first workspace folder; relative paths are resolved by the server from the folder containing each shader. An explicitly configured array replaces file-derived directories.

hlsl.virtualDirectoryMappings.description: Virtual include roots (keys beginning with / or \) mapped to existing directories. The value is selected from the first workspace folder; relative targets are resolved by the server from the folder containing each shader.

hlsl.targetProfile.description: Optional DXC target profile, such as ps_6_6 or lib_6_8. When explicitly configured, this overrides shadertoolsconfig.json.

hlsl.entryPoint.description: Optional shader entry point supplied to DXC. When explicitly configured, this overrides shadertoolsconfig.json.

hlsl.additionalArguments.description: Additional DXC arguments, for example -enable-16bit-types. An explicitly configured array replaces file-derived arguments.

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run build && node scripts/run-integration.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out hlsl-lsp-vscode.vsix
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
